Phone requests also require that member’s quiet-phone request opt-in. Unsupported trackers are skipped. A complete selected Life360 Circle with one enabled account can use the external integration’s saved authorization for an unofficial Circle-wide request; otherwise only a supported targeted action is used. HomeCircle-managed connections check cloud reports. Household viewers need control permission for each target. Requests and HA updates do not guarantee new GPS fixes. No credentials are sent to the card.

life360_account.title: Connect Life360
life360_account.description:
This optional connection uses an unofficial Life360 API. HomeCircle is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Life360. Access can stop or lead to account restrictions. Use only accounts and location sharing you are entitled to access, and review the [Life360 terms](https://legal.corp.life360.com/hc/en-us/articles/42963368361239-Life360-Terms-of-Service-2026-8). This acknowledgement does not grant provider permission.

Enter your email and password, or an access token. Some accounts with verified phone numbers cannot use password sign-in. Credentials stay in your Home Assistant configuration storage; protect storage and backups. Recorder may retain tracker locations. Trackers may take several minutes to appear; reopen HomeCircle Options to select them. Reports may be delayed; HomeCircle is not an emergency or safety service.

findmy_add.title: Connect Apple Find My
findmy_add.description:
This optional connection uses unofficial Apple services. HomeCircle is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple. Access can stop or lead to account restrictions. Use only accounts, items and location sharing you are entitled to access. Review the [iCloud terms](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/icloud/en/terms.html) and [Apple software terms](https://www.apple.com/legal/sla/docs/iTunes.pdf). This acknowledgement does not grant provider permission.

After you continue, HomeCircle downloads identity libraries from Apple's iTunes 12.8.3 installer when needed and runs CoreADI under emulation in Home Assistant. It may appear in your Apple device list. Discovering new items requires a trusted device's unlock passcode; reconnecting existing items needs Apple sign-in. HomeCircle does not join a new Keychain trust peer. Passwords, verification codes and passcodes stay transient. Selected item keys, account email, client identity, provisioning state and the report-service token are saved in a local encrypted store; its encryption key is alongside it. Protect HA storage and backups. Household viewers can see selected item locations. Reports may be delayed; HomeCircle is not an emergency or safety service.

data.consent: I understand the risks and allow Apple sign-in and selected-item key recovery
data.label: Account label

findmy_login.title: Sign in to Apple
findmy_login.description: Enter your Apple account details here. Each submission starts one sign-in attempt. Verification and recovery continue in Home Assistant.

findmy_code.title: Enter Apple verification code
findmy_code.description: {verification_notice} Use the newest verification code for this sign-in. This is different from a device unlock passcode.

findmy_device.title: Choose a trusted device
findmy_device.description: Choose the device whose unlock passcode you know. Names come from Apple; a serial suffix distinguishes unnamed devices.

findmy_passcode.title: Recover Find My item keys
findmy_passcode.description: Enter the selected device’s unlock passcode. HomeCircle never retries it automatically. Rejected or uncertain submissions are retained locally across setup restarts; Apple’s own retry allowance is unknown.

findmy_select.title: Choose Find My items
findmy_select.description: Your current items are already selected. Add items or deliberately uncheck any that should stop polling. Saving replaces the selection. Unchecked tracking keys are discarded; existing history and saved display settings are kept.

findmy_types.title: Set item types
findmy_types.description:
Choose a type for each selected item in this order. Apple may omit the type.

{items}

findmy_confirm.title: Save selected Find My items

data.confirm: Save this account and these selected items

findmy_disconnect.title: Disconnect Apple account
findmy_disconnect.description: Disconnect {account}? Its polling and HomeCircle item cards stop. The HomeCircle account session and item keys are deleted from HA storage; existing backups are not changed. Tracker history is retained. Local recovery safeguard counts are retained.

findmy_zone.title: Check Find My access
findmy_zone.description: Apple sign-in succeeded, but HomeCircle must be able to access your Find My item storage before device recovery. Continue to retry this read-only check. No device unlock passcode is needed.

findmy_discovery.title: Retry Find My item discovery
findmy_discovery.description: Your device passcode recovery succeeded. Recovered keys stay in memory until this setup closes or expires. Continue to retry item discovery without entering the passcode again.

findmy_saved_items.title: Manage saved Find My items
findmy_saved_items.description: Choose among item keys already saved for this account. Opening and selecting saved items stays local: it does not ask for a password or device passcode, repeat Apple authentication or discover new items. Normal Apple report polling continues or resumes after saving. This does not renew an expired Apple session. Removed items stop being tracked after you confirm.

findmy_recovery_reset.title: Review the recovery safeguard
findmy_recovery_reset.description: This installation recorded {rejected} refused exchanges and {uncertain} uncertain submissions for this Apple account. Starting setup again does not clear them. Apple may limit recovery attempts; HomeCircle cannot determine its remaining allowance. Clear this local safeguard only after reviewing the device and passcode you intend to use. This does not reset Apple’s allowance or submit another passcode.

data.acknowledge: I understand the limits and want to clear this local safeguard

findmy_recovery_resume.title: Finish recovering item keys
findmy_recovery_resume.description: The recovery exchange was verified and its material is still held in this setup. Continue to retry the remaining key download without another device-passcode proof.

findmy_recovery_review.title: Review recovery after setup or restore
findmy_recovery_review.description: HomeCircle cannot verify the continuity of this Apple account’s local recovery safeguard. This can happen on first setup, after an upgrade from an older safeguard, after restoring a backup, or if local cache files were removed. The saved record shows {rejected} refused exchanges and {uncertain} uncertain submissions, but an older backup may omit newer submissions. New device-passcode submissions are blocked. Review the device and passcode before acknowledging. This clears only this account’s local safeguard; it does not reset Apple’s allowance, sign in or submit a passcode. Saved item tracking can continue.

data.acknowledge: I have reviewed the device and passcode and understand the local safeguard may be incomplete

abort.findmy_recovery_uncertain: The recovery submission outcome could not be verified. It is retained as uncertain by the local safeguard; no automatic retry was sent. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_no_recovery_device: Apple did not provide a recoverable trusted device. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_recovery_review: HomeCircle could not verify local recovery continuity. No new device-passcode submission was sent. Review the recovery safeguard before continuing.
abort.provider_paused: This connection is paused. Open Manage direct connections to review and deliberately resume it.
abort.provider_controls_failed: HomeCircle could not safely read or save connection controls. Requests are stopped. Check local storage before continuing.
abort.provider_control_saved: Connection control saved. Paused connections remain paused after a restart. Accounts, selected trackers and history are kept.
abort.not_admin: Only a Home Assistant administrator can manage direct connections.
abort.provider_controls_storage_failed: Direct requests are blocked now, but the setting could not be saved. Check Home Assistant storage before restarting.

life360_account.title: Connect Life360
life360_account.description:
This optional connection uses an unofficial Life360 API. HomeCircle is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Life360. Access can stop or lead to account restrictions. Use only accounts and location sharing you are entitled to access, and review the [Life360 terms](https://legal.corp.life360.com/hc/en-us/articles/42963368361239-Life360-Terms-of-Service-2026-8). This acknowledgement does not grant provider permission.

Enter your email and password, or an access token. Some accounts with verified phone numbers cannot use password sign-in. Credentials stay in your Home Assistant configuration storage; protect storage and backups. Recorder may retain tracker locations. Trackers may take several minutes to appear; reopen HomeCircle Options to select them. Reports may be delayed; HomeCircle is not an emergency or safety service.

findmy_add.title: Connect Apple Find My
findmy_add.description:
This optional connection uses unofficial Apple services. HomeCircle is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple. Access can stop or lead to account restrictions. Use only accounts, items and location sharing you are entitled to access. Review the [iCloud terms](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/icloud/en/terms.html) and [Apple software terms](https://www.apple.com/legal/sla/docs/iTunes.pdf). This acknowledgement does not grant provider permission.

After you continue, HomeCircle downloads identity libraries from Apple's iTunes 12.8.3 installer when needed and runs CoreADI under emulation in Home Assistant. It may appear in your Apple device list. Discovering new items requires a trusted device's unlock passcode; reconnecting existing items needs Apple sign-in. HomeCircle does not join a new Keychain trust peer. Passwords, verification codes and passcodes stay transient. Selected item keys, account email, client identity, provisioning state and the report-service token are saved in a local encrypted store; its encryption key is alongside it. Protect HA storage and backups. Household viewers can see selected item locations. Reports may be delayed; HomeCircle is not an emergency or safety service.

findmy_passcode.title: Recover Find My item keys
findmy_passcode.description: Enter the selected device’s unlock passcode. HomeCircle never retries it automatically. Rejected or uncertain submissions are retained locally across setup restarts; Apple’s own retry allowance is unknown.

{items}

findmy_disconnect.title: Disconnect Apple account
findmy_disconnect.description: Disconnect {account}? Its polling and HomeCircle item cards stop. The HomeCircle account session and item keys are deleted from HA storage; existing backups are not changed. Tracker history is retained. Local recovery safeguard counts are retained.

findmy_zone.title: Check Find My access
findmy_zone.description: Apple sign-in succeeded, but HomeCircle must be able to access your Find My item storage before device recovery. Continue to retry this read-only check. No device unlock passcode is needed.

findmy_discovery.title: Retry Find My item discovery
findmy_discovery.description: Your device passcode recovery succeeded. Recovered keys stay in memory until this setup closes or expires. Continue to retry item discovery without entering the passcode again.

findmy_saved_items.title: Manage saved Find My items
findmy_saved_items.description: Choose among item keys already saved for this account. Opening and selecting saved items stays local: it does not ask for a password or device passcode, repeat Apple authentication or discover new items. Normal Apple report polling continues or resumes after saving. This does not renew an expired Apple session. Removed items stop being tracked after you confirm.

findmy_recovery_reset.title: Review the recovery safeguard
findmy_recovery_reset.description: This installation recorded {rejected} refused exchanges and {uncertain} uncertain submissions for this Apple account. Starting setup again does not clear them. Apple may limit recovery attempts; HomeCircle cannot determine its remaining allowance. Clear this local safeguard only after reviewing the device and passcode you intend to use. This does not reset Apple’s allowance or submit another passcode.

data.acknowledge: I understand the limits and want to clear this local safeguard

findmy_recovery_resume.title: Finish recovering item keys
findmy_recovery_resume.description: The recovery exchange was verified and its material is still held in this setup. Continue to retry the remaining key download without another device-passcode proof.

findmy_recovery_review.title: Review recovery after setup or restore
findmy_recovery_review.description: HomeCircle cannot verify the continuity of this Apple account’s local recovery safeguard. This can happen on first setup, after an upgrade from an older safeguard, after restoring a backup, or if local cache files were removed. The saved record shows {rejected} refused exchanges and {uncertain} uncertain submissions, but an older backup may omit newer submissions. New device-passcode submissions are blocked. Review the device and passcode before acknowledging. This clears only this account’s local safeguard; it does not reset Apple’s allowance, sign in or submit a passcode. Saved item tracking can continue.

data.acknowledge: I have reviewed the device and passcode and understand the local safeguard may be incomplete

error.findmy_missing_item_identity: This item has no usable identity. The existing selection was not replaced.
error.findmy_recovery_rate_limited: Apple refused recovery authentication with HTTP 429. The cause is unconfirmed. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code. No device-passcode submission was sent.
error.findmy_recovery_review: HomeCircle could not verify local recovery continuity. No new device-passcode submission was sent. Review the recovery safeguard before continuing.
error.provider_acknowledgement_required: Review the unofficial connection notice and acknowledge it before connecting.
error.provider_paused: This connection is paused. Open Manage direct connections to review and deliberately resume it.
error.provider_controls_failed: HomeCircle could not safely read or save connection controls. Requests are stopped. Check local storage before continuing.
error.invalid_provider_control: Choose a saved connection and either Pause or Resume.
error.provider_controls_storage_failed: Direct requests are blocked now, but the setting could not be saved. Check Home Assistant storage before restarting.

abort.place_import_no_account: No saved Life360 connection is available. Connect Life360 first, then try again.
abort.place_import_none: No new valid places are available to import. Existing zones and Primary Home are excluded.
abort.place_import_skipped: All selected places were skipped. No zones were created.
abort.tracker_picture_only: Use Home Assistant People settings to change a Person picture.
abort.findmy_no_items: Apple returned no Find My items.
abort.findmy_storage_failed: The saved session could not be safely read or written. It was not replaced.
abort.findmy_report_access_unavailable: HomeCircle could not obtain a usable Find My tracking credential after Apple sign-in. The existing connection was not replaced.
abort.findmy_code_signin_failed: Apple verification returned, but the follow-up sign-in could not finish. The verification code may have been correct. Stop retrying and check the integration diagnostics. No connection was saved or replaced.
abort.findmy_code_delegate_failed: The follow-up Apple authentication finished, but access to iCloud services failed. Stop retrying codes and check the integration diagnostics. No connection was saved or replaced.
abort.findmy_verification_limit: Apple kept requesting more verification. Close this setup before starting another sign-in attempt. No connection was saved or replaced.
abort.findmy_signin_state: This setup session cannot sign in again. Close setup and start a new attempt. No connection was saved or replaced.
abort.findmy_account_mismatch: Use the same Apple account when reconnecting. An account already connected must be managed from its existing entry. No connection was saved or replaced.
abort.findmy_initial_refused: Apple rejected the initial sign-in challenge before checking the password proof. This response does not establish that your password is incorrect. Close setup and review the integration diagnostics before another attempt. No connection was saved or replaced.
abort.findmy_identity_failed: HomeCircle could not prepare its Apple identity. No Apple account credentials were checked or saved. Start setup again after checking the HA connection and HomeCircle diagnostics.
abort.findmy_recovery_storage: HomeCircle could not safely read or save its recovery safeguard. Recovery has stopped; a submission already in progress may have an unknown outcome. Check local storage permissions and available space before continuing.
abort.findmy_recovery_signin_required: Recovery needs a fresh Apple sign-in or another verification step. Start a new setup and sign in again. This local failure does not establish that a device passcode was wrong.
abort.findmy_recovery_material_failed: The recovery exchange was verified, but its recovered material could not be opened. Check diagnostics before starting a new setup. No automatic passcode retry was sent.
abort.findmy_identity_unavailable: HomeCircle could not safely verify the saved item identities. The existing selection was not replaced.
abort.findmy_settings_changed: Find My settings changed in another setup. Reopen HomeCircle settings before saving this draft.
abort.findmy_duplicate_item: More than one item matched the same saved identity. The existing selection was not replaced. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_missing_item_identity: This item has no usable identity. The existing selection was not replaced. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_recovery_failed: Apple sign-in completed, but Find My key recovery could not open. Check HomeCircle diagnostics before starting a new attempt. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_recovery_limit: HomeCircle has recorded three rejected or uncertain recovery submissions for this Apple account. Starting setup again does not clear this local safeguard. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_recovery_protocol: HomeCircle could not safely prepare or validate the recovery exchange. Check diagnostics before trying again; this does not establish a wrong passcode. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_recovery_rate_limited: Apple refused recovery authentication with HTTP 429. The cause is unconfirmed. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code. No device-passcode submission was sent.
abort.findmy_recovery_refused: Apple refused the recovery exchange. This does not establish that the device passcode was wrong. Check the chosen device and diagnostics before another deliberate attempt. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_recovery_transient: A temporary connection or service problem interrupted recovery preparation. No automatic passcode retry was sent. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_recovery_uncertain: The recovery submission outcome could not be verified. It is retained as uncertain by the local safeguard; no automatic retry was sent. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_no_recovery_device: Apple did not provide a recoverable trusted device. This sign-in has ended; do not reuse the verification code.
abort.findmy_recovery_review: HomeCircle could not verify local recovery continuity. No new device-passcode submission was sent. Review the recovery safeguard before continuing.
abort.provider_paused: This connection is paused. Open Manage direct connections to review and deliberately resume it.
abort.provider_controls_failed: HomeCircle could not safely read or save connection controls. Requests are stopped. Check local storage before continuing.
abort.provider_control_saved: Connection control saved. Paused connections remain paused after a restart. Accounts, selected trackers and history are kept.
abort.not_admin: Only a Home Assistant administrator can manage direct connections.
abort.provider_controls_storage_failed: Direct requests are blocked now, but the setting could not be saved. Check Home Assistant storage before restarting.

progress.findmy_connecting: Connecting to Apple. Keep this window open; you may cancel to discard this setup.

tracker_provider_start_failed.title: HomeCircle tracker connection could not start
tracker_provider_start_failed.description: HomeCircle could not start {provider}. Its managed trackers may be unavailable. Other tracker connections and selected Home Assistant sources continue running. Check Home Assistant dependency and startup logs, resolve the startup problem, then reload HomeCircle.

missing_entities.title: HomeCircle selections need attention
missing_entities.description: {count} selected entities are missing or disabled. Sources may still be starting. If they do not return, open HomeCircle Options to remove or replace them. Renamed entities must be selected again. Saved selections are retained; missing sources are not treated as Away.

life360_auth_failed.title: HomeCircle Life360 sign-in needs attention
life360_auth_failed.description: The direct Life360 connection is no longer authorized. Its trackers may be unavailable. Check the account authorization and reconnect HomeCircle; existing Home Assistant sources remain available.

findmy_account_auth.title: Apple Find My sign-in needs attention
findmy_account_auth.description: The Apple Find My account {account} needs a new sign-in. In HomeCircle settings, open Apple Find My accounts, choose this account, and reconnect. Other accounts continue polling. Passwords and codes must be entered in setup, not logs or support reports.

findmy_storage_cleanup.title: Find My session cleanup needs attention
findmy_storage_cleanup.description: HomeCircle could not safely remove a native Find My session store. Other providers continue running. Protect HA storage and backups, and review HomeCircle storage permissions before retrying cleanup. No files with unexpected ownership or type were deleted.

findmy_migration_recovery.title: Find My migration needs attention
findmy_migration_recovery.description: HomeCircle could not finish a pending Find My migration. The affected migration account is paused; other accounts and providers continue. The original prototype session and migration ledger are retained. Review the registered tracker identities and reload HomeCircle after fixing the conflict. Disconnecting this paused migration account completes rollback and can re-enable the existing prototype.
